context: If ν satisfies α-LSI, then along the gradient flow (10), d Hν (ρ) = −Jν (ρ) ≤ −2αHν (ρ), dt which implies exponential convergence in relative entropy: Hν (ρt ) ≤ e−2αt Hν (ρ0 ). This also implies exponential convergence of the distance W2 (ρt , ν), since LSI implies the Talagrand inequality: W2 (ρ, ν)2 ≤ α2 Hν (ρ), ∀ ρ ∈ P (Talagrand, 1996; Otto and Villani, 2000). This is because in general gradient domination implies the sufficient growth property, see Appendix C.1. 3.1.3.
